svg.title: examples/site/icons.tsx, before and after
svg.desc: main on the left, this branch on the right, playing in sync.

svg.title: Icons
svg.desc: Eight Tabler icons arrive in eight ways: a rocket draws on, a heart pops, a box drops, a gear spins in, an eye comes into focus, wifi bars cascade, a sun swaps for a moon and a bell draws on and rings.

g.text: <Icon icon={rocket} animation={(d, i) => draw({ at: i * 0.14, over: 0.5 })} />
